execution_script:
server_address = inputs["Server Address"]
path = inputs["Workflow Path"]
graphInputs = inputs["Inputs"] or {}
if graphInputs and isinstance(graphInputs, str):
    graphInputs = eval(graphInputs)

waitForCompletion = inputs["Wait For Completion"]
output_dir = inputs["Output Dir"]
result = core.getPlugin("ComfyUI").submitGraphToLocal(path=path, inputs=graphInputs, waitForCompletion=waitForCompletion, output_dir=output_dir, server_address=server_address)
GeneratedFiles = result.get("downloaded_files", [])
if not GeneratedFiles:
    error = result.get("error") if isinstance(result, dict) else ""
    if error:
        raise Exception(error)
    raise Exception("Failed to submit workflow: %s" % result)
